## Known biases

Registry: MRMS was upgraded from version 11 to 12 on 2020-10-14 and products before that date should be used with caution (the AWS archive starts on 2020-10-14). Pass 1 has a 20-minute latency and Pass 2 a 1-hour latency (NSSL table); the grid resolution of the files was not read (no file downloaded) so it is not recorded here. The mtarchive copy for 2021-09-01 has no Pass 1 or 15-minute product, only Pass 2, RadarOnly 1H and PrecipRate.
